title: Hinomori Shiho — Brand New Style〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 2-B

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Oh, I forgot to put away the results of my checkup. I should do that before I head off for lunch...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (159 cm tall...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I don't care that much about my height, but...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Heehee! This means I'm officially more of a lady than you, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I really didn't grow at all this past year...?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(I mean, Shizuku's pretty tall...
So what's her secret?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Is stretching important?
She usually does after taking baths and stuff.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(I might try asking her about that later.
And...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(What if I did a search for...?
“How to grow taller”...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Huh? “Hang from the monkey bars”?
Does that actually work...?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (“Getting enough calcium and sleep is key”... Okay, this makes a lot more sense.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiiiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? Saki?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry!
I didn't mean to scare you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're fine. I was just thinking about something...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, what's up?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Lunch! That's what's up!
Remember how we talked about us eating with Emu today?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Sorry, gimme one sec.
I need to go grab something at the school store.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, you're buying lunch today?
Then, Emu and I will be waiting at our seats.
Several minutes later

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow, Emu, your lunch box is as big as always!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I'm still amazed by how you can eat all this food.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I need to eat a lot to do my best during afternoon classes☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, Saki, your Salisbury steaks look like stars! And it's so cute how the sauce sparkles!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. My mom made these for me!
The ones she makes are really juicy and delicious!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
They look really yummy!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Then, I'll share some with you.
I really want you to taste them for yourself!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really?! Then, Saki, you can have anything you want from my lunch!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Cool! Let's trade!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho, how about...? Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What is it...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You're drinking milk...?
But you always get tea.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, um...
I felt like having milk today.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, okay.
You felt like... Wait, milk...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Is your height bothering you?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Lemme guess. You were thinking about your measurement results just now!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, you're wrong.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, does that mean...?
Shiho, you wanna grow taller?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
If so, we should ask Rui!
He's so tall that I have to go on my very tippy toes every time I talk to him!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Yeah, Kamishiro is pretty tall even for a boy his age.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Girls don't grow the same way as boys, but it might be worth asking what he eats on a regular basis...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
No, what are you talking about?
I'm having milk today because I felt like it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh? Fine, be that way.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I'll still let you have some of my Salisbury steaks. So that you grow big and strong♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Seriously, I'm not that bothered by my height or anything...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But I might buy some milk on my way home and try to go to bed early tonight.)
